description: Held-out log (qualification_protocol.md, reserved held-out pool and E5). Each receipt records a passing dev-rehearsal (accept.py --receipt): id, gpu, candidate, route, code_commit, candidate_args, evidence_sha256 (the development evidence digest), verdict_sha256, status and exit_code. Commit a receipt, as a change to this file only, before the draw that names it, and make the rehearsed development outputs read-only; the final acceptance reuses that evidence unchanged. Each draw records id, gpu, candidate, code_commit (the candidate's code revision), candidate_args (its declared arguments beyond the stock command), receipt (the id of its earlier rehearsal receipt), seeds (two per held-out row) and zn_extra. A receipt is named by at most one draw, and a candidate (code_commit and ordered candidate_args) is drawn at most once. Commit a draw, as a change to this file only, before running off or the candidate on any held-out row; append H3's extra Zn seeds one at a time, each committed before its run. Never edit or remove an entry: the acceptance command requires the file's Git history to be append-only. Seeds are drawn from 201-999 (widened from 201-299 in qual-sm120-contract-6) and are single-use across every draw.
